purpose: Strict static imports for six contract-only domain modules; future task scopes may revise only through review and new tests.
rules: core must never depend on other domains, UI, renderer, or external runtime packages.
Each feature domain may import only itself and core, never another feature domain.
Cross-domain core imports must use @domain/core; relative imports must remain inside the importing module.
Domain code may not import UI, renderer, game, libraries or Node built-ins, even as type-only imports.
Dynamic import(), require(), and import-equals are denied in domain files; dependency edges must be statically auditable.
Architecture contracts are not a game simulation, event schema, save schema, route state, or storage implementation.

postBoundaryMilestones.L3-026: type-only domain event contracts for four categories (core only)
